// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test inputs/oracles: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors; adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Extract the complete pinned TestParseExpr_ShouldValidateLabelComparison matrix.
// This small AST interpreter expands the original loops and reads require assertions;
// it neither calls Pulse nor invents parser outcomes. Pass parser_test.go as argv[1].
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

type row struct {
	Query    string   `json:"query"`
	Reject   bool     `json:"reject"`
	Contains []string `json:"error_contains,omitempty"`
}

func main() {
	source, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	must(err)
	if fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(source)) != "0a8466fd5d9cab3f852f9a18a52dc54b7b1a1ab0c9c6af53ca1df21d9f38ce99" {
		panic("source differs from pinned Loki parser_test.go")
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, os.Args[1], source, 0)
	must(err)
	for _, decl := range f.Decls {
		fn, ok := decl.(*ast.FuncDecl)
		if !ok || fn.Name.Name != "TestParseExpr_ShouldValidateLabelComparison" {
			continue
		}
		selection := source[fs.Position(fn.Pos()).Offset:fs.Position(fn.End()).Offset]
		selection = append(selection, '\n')
		rows := []row{}
		walk(fn.Body, map[string]any{}, &rows)
		out := map[string]any{
			"revision":         "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d",
			"source":           "pkg/logql/syntax/parser_test.go",
			"test":             fn.Name.Name,
			"source_sha256":    fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(source)),
			"selection_sha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(selection)),
			"rows":             rows,
		}
		e := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
		e.SetIndent("", "  ")
		must(e.Encode(out))
		return
	}
	panic("missing upstream function")
}

func value(e ast.Expr, env map[string]any) any {
	switch x := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		s, err := strconv.Unquote(x.Value)
		must(err)
		return s
	case *ast.Ident:
		v, ok := env[x.Name]
		if !ok {
			panic("unknown variable: " + x.Name)
		}
		return v
	case *ast.CompositeLit:
		values := []string{}
		for _, elt := range x.Elts {
			values = append(values, value(elt, env).(string))
		}
		return values
	case *ast.CallExpr:
		if sel, ok := x.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "fmt" && sel.Sel.Name == "Sprintf" {
			args := []any{}
			for _, arg := range x.Args[1:] {
				args = append(args, value(arg, env))
			}
			return fmt.Sprintf(value(x.Args[0], env).(string), args...)
		}
	}
	panic(fmt.Sprintf("unsupported expression %T", e))
}

func walk(block *ast.BlockStmt, env map[string]any, rows *[]row) {
	// Leaf callbacks contain the original ParseExpr invocation and assertions.
	var query ast.Expr
	var reject, accept bool
	contains := []string{}
	for _, stmt := range block.List {
		if a, ok := stmt.(*ast.AssignStmt); ok {
			if call, ok := a.Rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
				if id, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.Ident); ok && id.Name == "ParseExpr" {
					query = call.Args[0]
				}
			}
		}
		if expr, ok := stmt.(*ast.ExprStmt); ok {
			if call, ok := expr.X.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
				if sel, ok := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr); ok && sel.X.(*ast.Ident).Name == "require" {
					switch sel.Sel.Name {
					case "Error":
						reject = true
					case "NoError":
						accept = true
					case "Contains":
						contains = append(contains, value(call.Args[2], env).(string))
					case "ErrorIs": // Original ErrParse assertion maps to HTTP parse_error.
					default:
						panic("unknown assertion")
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if query != nil {
		if reject == accept {
			panic("ambiguous oracle")
		}
		*rows = append(*rows, row{value(query, env).(string), reject, contains})
		return
	}
	for _, stmt := range block.List {
		switch x := stmt.(type) {
		case *ast.AssignStmt:
			env[x.Lhs[0].(*ast.Ident).Name] = value(x.Rhs[0], env)
		case *ast.RangeStmt:
			for _, v := range value(x.X, env).([]string) {
				child := map[string]any{}
				for k, old := range env {
					child[k] = old
				}
				child[x.Value.(*ast.Ident).Name] = v
				walk(x.Body, child, rows)
			}
		case *ast.ExprStmt:
			call := x.X.(*ast.CallExpr)
			sel := call.Fun.(*ast.SelectorExpr)
			if sel.X.(*ast.Ident).Name != "t" || sel.Sel.Name != "Run" {
				panic("unexpected call")
			}
			walk(call.Args[1].(*ast.FuncLit).Body, env, rows)
		default:
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("unsupported statement %T", stmt))
		}
	}
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
